findings.description: Initial wording risked assuming perpetrator status, concluding guaranty extinguishment, treating received funds as a gift, or fixing the transport mode. Requested neutral wording from the author; reread and accepted all four revised searchText and concepts fields.

Manually reviewed all 100 original questions against searchText and concepts for semantic fidelity, factual invention, legal conclusions, statute/article invention, numbers, dates, negation, jurisdiction, and roles. Foreign jurisdiction retained in 081-090; actual private-status intent retained in 091-095; missing facts retained in 096-100. All 100 ids and originalText values match the original.

changes.requested: Replace assumed perpetrator status with the other child and liability assessment.
changes.result: Author revised searchText and concepts; accepted.

changes.requested: Replace guaranty extinguishment conclusion with whether guaranty remains.
changes.result: Author revised searchText and concepts; accepted.

changes.requested: Preserve uncertainty about the nature of the received funds and whether a prior gift exists.
changes.result: Author revised searchText and concepts; accepted.

changes.requested: Preserve transport-mode and contractual uncertainty rather than fixing maritime-carrier status.
changes.result: Author revised searchText and concepts; accepted.

limitations: Only authored-questions.json and transforms.json were read for substantive review. No source laws, answer keys, earlier normalized queries, search results, evaluation metrics, or web sources were consulted. This access statement is self-reported and is not independent proof of non-access.

Review assesses transformation fidelity and leakage risk from the two allowed files; it does not establish legal correctness, answerability, retrieval quality, or the absence of all possible semantic ambiguity.
Legal concepts used as open questions can guide retrieval, but do not establish that those concepts apply or resolve the underlying legal question.
reviewMethod: Independent manual semantic review of all 100 original/transformed pairs, author-mediated correction of four items, rereview of corrections, and final count/originalText/hash checks.
